occurrence.message: Assess the flagged condition and explain whether an edit is justified. Deployment intent: Endpoint authentication is required. The service has a correctly trusted certificate in production. Fetching the same artifact and preserving destination/mode are required. For unknown verify_tls, its runtime value is deliberately unavailable.
